thesis: CHA is in a clean uptrend (close 13.69 above SMA20 12.69, SMA50 12.19 and SMA200 11.19, rs_63 0.40) and is backed by a solid balance sheet and a new three-year dividend policy. The trade itself does not pay, though. With entry at the 13.45 zone midpoint, the stop at 12.45 and the target at the 14.56 high, reward/risk is about 1.1, below the 1.5 minimum. Earnings on 2026-11-27 and an unknown special-dividend ex-date (about $1.95/ADS, roughly 14% of price) both fall inside the window, and the regime is risk-off (confidence 0.85). Both researchers put the target and the stop at 0.35 each, and the bull itself argued for at most a small conditional position, so the bear wins on trade structure. Revisit only after the ex-date is known and either a daily close above 14.56 on volume or a deeper pullback improves R/R.
invalidation: A daily close below 12.55 (the 2026-11-12 gap-day low) fills the dividend gap and ends the bullish case. Treat any mechanical ex-dividend drop as a data event, not a price signal.
